title: Coefficient-estimation input
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, the coefficient-estimation input consists of its coefficient-bias parameters and its original Fourier $1$-norm bound, which is at least one.
hypotheses_covered: The input has valid small-bias parameters: $n>0$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$
The Fourier $1$-norm bound is at least one
